ppi_focus: Rear subframe mounting points and trunk-floor spot welds around the differential ears: look for cracking, tearing or prior welding and reinforcement.
Cooling system: radiator end tanks, expansion tank, water pump weep, thermostat housing, hoses; pressure test and combustion-gas test.
S52 VANOS: cold-start rattle and fault codes; check the valve cover gasket and oil filter housing gasket for leaks.
Scan all modules for stored codes, check OBD readiness monitors, and assess smog feasibility for CA.
Rear trailing-arm bushings, rear shock mounts, differential mount and output seals for leaks.
Clutch engagement point and slip test; transmission and differential fluid condition; limited-slip function.
Rocker and floor-pan corrosion (humid Southeast car); inspect under the carpets and at the jacking points.
Tire date codes and type; brake rotor and pad thickness.
Soft top fabric and frame; OEM hardtop latches and seals; window regulators.
Paint meter on all panels to back up the no-reported-accident history.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: dated cooling-system and subframe/trunk-floor receipts or photos, plus a clean specialist PPI, would substantially raise documentation and condition.
Up: an out-the-door price negotiated into or near the $17,583–$22,877 fair-value range would move price value from poor to acceptable.
Down: any trunk-floor cracking, subframe tearing, coolant loss or undisclosed paintwork found at inspection.
Down: the dealer refusing an independent PPI or refusing to send underside and trunk-floor photos.
evidence.mission_note: An S52 manual M Roadster in Estoril Blue with a hardtop fits the future-keeper brief well on specification. However, it is priced above the ideal band during a cash-preservation, accelerated-bridge period, so it is attractive only as a keeper and does not solve the bridge need.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well. The VIN decodes to a 2000 Z3 M with a 3.2L, consistent with the preferred S52, and an AutoCheck summary shows a clean title, 0 reported accidents and 3 owners. The photos show a straight, visibly stock Estoril Blue car with OEM Roadstar wheels and a hardtop fitted, with mildly hazed headlight lenses. Nothing about maintenance is established: there are no records, no cooling-system history and no rear subframe or trunk-floor evidence, which are the two model-critical items for an S52 M Roadster. The S54 rod-bearing item does not apply to this car. The ad contradicts itself on whether fees are included and states a separate $599 dealer fee on top of $25,598. That ask sits above the $17,583–$22,877 fair-value range, and nearby-mileage sold comps closed at $20,000–$23,000. Tires, interior, soft top, warning lights and PPI access all remain unexamined.
evidence.next_action: Email the dealer asking for (1) written permission for an independent BMW PPI with lift inspection in the Atlanta area before any deposit, (2) trunk-floor and underside photos, (3) any service records and tire date codes, and (4) a written out-the-door price.
